scores.rationale: Phases run from skeleton → data model/convergence → access → editing → scale → rollout, with each phase gated by validation and the dependency map blocking specification until V1 passes.

scores.evidence: GitHub Actions builds the image and Terraform/Helm deploys it to production. OpenTelemetry traces run end to end
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real end-to-end production slice (login, type, sync, persist, reload) with deploy, rollback and a V0 gate.

scores.evidence: CRDT using Yjs | ... | V1 fails, then switch to OT with the server ordering edits
scores.rationale: Irreversible decisions are listed with reversibility class, default, assumption, validator and explicit flip condition.

scores.evidence: Phase 1: Data model and convergence (the change that would force the most rework if wrong)
scores.rationale: Widest-impact items (schema, convergence, workspace_id) come first, and within Phase 3 presence/cursors are deliberately last as leaf work.

scores.evidence: Allow-list login, TLS, secrets in a vault
scores.rationale: The cross-cutting table gives concrete security items in every phase from Phase 0 through Phase 5.

scores.evidence: Traces, logs, error-rate alert; no document content in telemetry
scores.rationale: Observability is concrete in Phase 0 and each later phase (metrics, denied-request alerts, SLO dashboards, cohort alarms).

scores.evidence: Infrastructure as code, pinned images, lockfiles
scores.rationale: Each phase has a concrete reproducibility item, such as versioned encoding, migrations in CI, seeded accounts, the fuzz corpus, load-test scripts and rollout config in git.
Resilience shows up in every phase, from rollback in Phase 0 through reconnect buffers, PITR and a halt-rollout rule.
The plan explicitly declares the AI layer not applicable and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Full offline-first editing: pull forward if product confirms editing offline for more than a reconnect.
scores.rationale: The deferred list is explicit, and each item has a concrete pull-forward condition.

note: Very strong plan that meets every rubric dimension with concrete content. Minor nit: Phase 0 security is light, but it is still concrete.
